examples.title: Embedded Viewer
examples.description: Runs the reporting engine locally from a ReportDefinition and IReportDataProvider.

examples.title: Remote Viewer
examples.description: Uses HTTP endpoints for metadata, snapshot rendering, and export.

examples.title: Explorer to Viewer Flow
examples.description: Shows a catalog with folder navigation and opens the selected report in the viewer.
examples.code:
<TmReportExplorer RootFolder="@_root"
                  Reports="@_reports"
                  CurrentFolderPath="@_folder"
                  CurrentFolderPathChanged="folder => _folder = folder"
                  ReportOpened="OpenReport" />

@if (_selectedSource is not null)
{
    <TmReportViewer ReportSource="@_selectedSource" />
}

examples.description: Registers Tempo.Blazor services, HttpClient, default text measurer, and PDF renderer dependencies used by reporting components.
